behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Independent field edits merge while a one-sided deletion is retained.
Delete versus explicit null conflict with presence-aware states.
docDelivery: Top-level atomic three-way resolution and structural equality rules.
Conflicting field omitted, sorted conflict states and detached value ownership.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Base/local/remote ordinary Object.prototype records, fields contain acyclic ordinary JSON data/dense arrays, no undefined/getters/custom methods/symbols/nonfinite numbers/-0. Field keys arbitrary ASCII. Object key order irrelevant, arrays ordered. Top-level fields merge atomically.
independence: Implement field-level three-way draft merge, deletion sentinels and conflict reporting relative to common base.
